abstractions.text: Values (state roots, hashes, versioned hashes) are Nat tokens; 0 is bytes32(0). Times are Nat seconds relative to an epoch (replay adds T_EPOCH).

Header bytes are presented honestly: a caller presents the stored header of the index it names. A fabricated header cannot match committedBatches (local premise CF(keccak256, {stored headers, presented header})), and only reaches the checks the model encodes for indices > LCI.
committedBatches is not stored: under the CF premise, committedBatches[k] != 0 <=> k <= LCI (committed indices are 0..LCI, contiguous).

Per-batch registers live in a window (indices LFI..LCI) and shadow lists (indices LCI+1, LCI+2, ...: residues left by revertBatch). Finalized indices below LFI keep only committedBatches and finalizedStateRoots, as in storage after finalizeBatch's deletes.
challenges and finalizedStateRoots are arrays indexed by absolute batch index.
keccak256 over blob hashes (version 2) is the stand-in agg(): an injective encoding offset by AGG_BASE (models CF(keccak256, S) for every finite S).
Neighbours are oracles: ISubmitter (isActive, challengeDeposit = DEP, slash deactivates), IRollupVerifier (accepts iff proof == 1), messenger (sendMessage appends to the queue).

Not modelled (coverage debt): reward/deposit accounting (batchChallengeReward, proveRemaining, claimReward, claimProveRemaining), withdrawalRoots, parameter updates, challenger/verifier admin, importGenesisBatch (the initial state is post-genesis), initialize3/4, dataHash contents.
